# Citation components

citeproc-js 2.4.63 by Frank Bennett, Copyright (c) 2009-2019 Frank Bennett.
Source: https://github.com/Juris-M/citeproc-js and npm citeproc@2.4.63.
Distributed under CPAL 1.0; see LICENSE and CPAL-1.0.txt. The only local engine
change wraps module.exports for direct browser use. Engine source is shipped
with this application at /web/vendor/csl/citeproc.js and in the public source repository.

APA 7 and GB/T 7714-2015 numeric styles from Citation Style Language styles;
en-US and zh-CN locales from Citation Style Language locales. Attribution and
revision dates are preserved in their XML info. These are distributed under
CC BY-SA 3.0; see CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt. No local changes to styles or locales.
Sources:
https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/apa.csl
https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/china-national-standard-gb-t-7714-2015-numeric.csl
https://github.com/citation-style-language/locales
